meta.name: competitor-tracker
meta.description: Use when the user asks to "track competitor influencer marketing", "see who my rivals partner with", or "benchmark my influencer program"; produces a competitor partnership roster, campaign and content-strategy breakdown, performance estimates, and a gap/opportunity list. Not for finding your own new creators — use influencer-discovery.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪竞品红人合作与营销策略
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想知道竞品与哪些红人合作、如何投放内容。
copy.tagline_en: Track competitor influencer partnerships and marketing strategies.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to know which influencers your rivals partner with and how they run campaigns.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会分析竞争对手的网红营销活动，生成一份报告，包含合作网红名单、活动分析、内容策略、效果估算和机会列表。
howto.when: 当你要求追踪竞争对手的网红营销、查看对手与谁合作，或评估自己的网红项目时触发。

say.text: 追踪 Glossier 的网红营销活动。
say.note: Claude 会分析 Glossier 的合作网红和活动。

say.text: 看看我的竞争对手在 TikTok 上跟哪些网红合作。
say.note: Claude 会聚焦 TikTok 平台进行分析。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude analyzes competitors' influencer marketing and produces a report including a partnership roster, campaign analysis, content strategy review, performance estimates, and an opportunity list.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to track a competitor's influencer marketing, see who rivals partner with, or benchmark your influencer program.

say_en.note: Claude will analyze Glossier's partners and campaigns.

say_en.text: Compare influencer strategies across Glossier, Fenty Beauty, and Rare Beauty.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a comparison report and opportunities.

say_en.text: Show me which influencers my competitors are missing in skincare.
